      (let ([seeds (seed-cells g bb)])
        (if (null? seeds) out
          (let ([color (third (last seeds))])
            (for/fold ([acc out]) ([p (inside bb)]) (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) color)))))))
  (let* ([interior-cells (remove-duplicates (append* (map inside original-boxes)))]
                 [groups (filter (lambda (obj) (not (= (obj-color obj) 0))) (ordered-objects filled))])
      (if (null? groups) filled
        (let* ([score (lambda (obj) (length (obj-cells obj)))]
               [best (apply max (map score groups))]
               [points (append* (map obj-cells (filter (lambda (obj) (= (score obj) best)) groups)))])
          (for/fold ([out filled]) ([p points]) (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 8))))))))
